arshift.tooltip: Returns val shifted by i bits to the right. If i is negative, a left shift is performed. Does an arithmetic shift: The most significant bit of n is propagated during the shift. Returns 0 if i < -31, or all sign bits if i > 31.

band.tooltip: Returns the bitwise AND of the given numbers.

bnot.tooltip: Returns the bitwise negation of val.

bor.tooltip: Returns the bitwise OR of the given numbers.

bxor.tooltip: Returns the bitwise XOR of the given numbers.

btest.tooltip: Returns true if the bitwise AND of the given numbers is non-zero.

extract.tooltip: Returns width bits from src, starting from bit index field. Raises an error if the selected bit range is goes outside the range [0, 31].

lrotate.tooltip: Returns val rotated by i bits to the left. If i is negative, a right rotate is performed.

lshift.tooltip: Returns val shifted by i bits to the left. If i is negative, a right shift is performed. Returns 0 if i is outside the [-31, 31] range.

replace.tooltip: Returns dst with width bits replaced from src, starting from bit index field. Raises an error if the selected bit range goes outside the range [0, 31].

rrotate.tooltip: Returns val rotated by i bits to the right. If i is negative, a left rotate is performed.

rshift.tooltip: Returns val shifted by i bits to the right. If i is negative, a left shift is performed. Returns 0 if i is outside the [-31, 31] range.

s32.tooltip: Returns val, wrapped from float64 range to signed int32 range and truncated to integer. Makes integer arithmetic compatable with LSL.

smul.tooltip: Returns the product of two signed 32-bit integers as a signed 32-bit integer, wrapping as necessary. Avoids precision loss associated with float64 multiplication. Compatible with LSL integer multiplication.

countlz.tooltip: Returns the count of val's leading zeros.

countrz.tooltip: Returns the count of val's trailing zeros.

byteswap.tooltip: Returns val with its bytes swapped to the reverse order.

buffer.tooltip: Buffer manipulation library for binary data.

create.tooltip: Creates a buffer of the requested size with all bytes initialized to 0.

fromstring.tooltip: Creates a buffer initialized to the contents of the string.

tostring.tooltip: Returns the buffer data as a string.

readi8.tooltip: Reads a signed 8-bit integer from the buffer at the given offset.

readu8.tooltip: Reads an unsigned 8-bit integer from the buffer at the given offset.

readi16.tooltip: Reads a signed 16-bit integer from the buffer at the given offset.

readu16.tooltip: Reads an unsigned 16-bit integer from the buffer at the given offset.

readi32.tooltip: Reads a signed 32-bit integer from the buffer at the given offset.

readinteger.tooltip: Reads a signed or unsigned 64-bit integer from the buffer at the given offset.

readu32.tooltip: Reads an unsigned 32-bit integer from the buffer at the given offset.

readf32.tooltip: Reads a 32-bit floating-point number from the buffer at the given offset.

readf64.tooltip: Reads a 64-bit floating-point number from the buffer at the given offset.

writei8.tooltip: Writes a signed 8-bit integer to the buffer at the given offset.

writeu8.tooltip: Writes an unsigned 8-bit integer to the buffer at the given offset.

writei16.tooltip: Writes a signed 16-bit integer to the buffer at the given offset.

writeu16.tooltip: Writes an unsigned 16-bit integer to the buffer at the given offset.

writei32.tooltip: Writes a signed 32-bit integer to the buffer at the given offset.

writeinteger.tooltip: Writes a signed or unsigned 64-bit integer to the buffer at the given offset.

writeu32.tooltip: Writes an unsigned 32-bit integer to the buffer at the given offset.

writef32.tooltip: Writes a 32-bit floating-point number to the buffer at the given offset.

writef64.tooltip: Writes a 64-bit floating-point number to the buffer at the given offset.

readstring.tooltip: Reads a string of the given length from the buffer at the specified offset.

writestring.tooltip: Writes data from a string into the buffer at the specified offset.

len.tooltip: Returns the size of the buffer in bytes.

copy.tooltip: Copies bytes from the source buffer into the target buffer.

fill.tooltip: Fills the buffer with the specified value starting at the given offset.

readbits.tooltip: Reads up to 32 bits from the buffer at the given offset.

writebits.tooltip: Writes up to 32 bits to the buffer at the given offset.

resume.tooltip: Resumes a coroutine. Returns true followed by any values passed to coroutine.yield() or returned by the function. If an error occurs, returns false and the error message.

running.tooltip: Returns the currently running coroutine, or nil if called from the main coroutine.

status.tooltip: Returns the status of the coroutine: "running", "suspended", "normal", or "dead".

wrap.tooltip: Creates a coroutine and returns a function that resumes it.

yield.tooltip: Yields the current coroutine, passing arguments to the resuming code.

isyieldable.tooltip: Returns true if the currently running coroutine can yield.

close.tooltip: Closes a coroutine, returning true if successful or false and an error.

info.tooltip: Returns information about a stack frame or function based on specified format.

traceback.tooltip: Returns a human-readable call stack starting from the specified level.

add.tooltip: Returns the sum of two 64-bit integers (signed or unsigned), wrapping on overflow.

arshift.tooltip: Returns val shifted by i bits to the right. If i is negative, a left shift is performed. Does an arithmetic shift: The most significant bit of n is propagated during the shift.

band.tooltip: Returns the bitwise AND of the given integers.

bnot.tooltip: Returns the bitwise negation of val.

bor.tooltip: Returns the bitwise OR of the given integers.

bxor.tooltip: Returns the bitwise XOR of the given integers.

bswap.tooltip: Returns val with its bytes swapped to the reverse order.

btest.tooltip: Returns true if the bitwise AND of the given integers is non-zero.

clamp.tooltip: Returns val clamped between min and max. Raises an error if min is greater than max.

countlz.tooltip: Returns the count of val's leading zeros.

countrz.tooltip: Returns the count of val's trailing zeros.

create.tooltip: Returns number val converted to an integer. Returns nil if it has a fractional part, is out of range, or is NaN.

div.tooltip: Returns dividend / divisor (signed), rounding toward zero. Raises an error if divisor is zero.

extract.tooltip: Returns width bits from src, starting from bit index field. Raises an error if the selected bit range is goes outside the range [0, 63].

fromstring.tooltip: Converts the input string to an integer in the specified base. Returns nil if not an integer.

idiv.tooltip: Returns dividend / divisor (signed), rounding toward negative infinity. Raises an error if divisor is zero.

lrotate.tooltip: Returns val rotated by i bits to the left. If i is negative, a right rotate is performed.

lshift.tooltip: Returns val shifted by i bits to the left. If i is negative, a right shift is performed. Returns 0 if i is outside the [-63, 63] range.

max.tooltip: Returns the maximum value from the given integers (signed).

min.tooltip: Returns the minimum value from the given integers (signed).

mod.tooltip: Returns the remainder of dividend / divisor (signed). The result always has the same sign as the divisor. Raises an error if divisor is zero.

mul.tooltip: Returns the product of two 64-bit integers (signed or unsigned), wrapping on overflow.

neg.tooltip: Returns the negation of val. integer.neg(integer.minsigned) == integer.minsigned due to overflow.

rem.tooltip: Returns the remainder of dividend / divisor (signed). The result always has the same sign as the dividend. Raises an error if divisor is zero.

replace.tooltip: Returns dst with width bits replaced from src, starting from bit index field. Raises an error if the selected bit range goes outside the range [0, 63].

rrotate.tooltip: Returns val rotated by i bits to the right. If i is negative, a left rotate is performed.

rshift.tooltip: Returns val shifted by i bits to the right. If i is negative, a left shift is performed. Returns 0 if i is outside the [-63, 63] range.

sub.tooltip: Returns the difference between two 64-bit integers (signed or unsigned), wrapping on overflow.

tonumber.tooltip: Returns the nearest float64 to the given int64. Is inexact above 2^53.

udiv.tooltip: Returns dividend / divisor (unsigned), rounding toward negative infinity. Raises an error if divisor is zero.

urem.tooltip: Returns the remainder of dividend / divisor (unsigned). Raises an error if divisor is zero.

encode.tooltip: Encodes a string or buffer to base64.

decode.tooltip: Decodes a base64 string to a string, or buffer if asBuffer is true. The output is truncated at the first decoding error.

lljson.tooltip: JSON encoding/decoding library for Second Life.

encode.tooltip: Encodes a Lua value as JSON. Raises an error if value contains unsupported types.

decode.tooltip: Decodes a JSON string to a Lua value. Raises an error if JSON is invalid.

slencode.tooltip: Encodes a Lua value as JSON, preserving SL types. Use tight to encode more compactly. Raises an error if value contains unsupported types.

sldecode.tooltip: Decodes a JSON string to a Lua value, preserving SL types. Raises an error if JSON is invalid.

null.tooltip: A constant to pass for null to json encode.

remove.tooltip: A constant to return from a reviver/replacer function to omit this item.

array_mt.tooltip: Metatable for declaring a table as an array for json encode.

object_mt.tooltip: Metatable for declaring a table as an object for json encode.

empty_array.tooltip: A constant to pass for an empty array to json encode.

empty_object.tooltip: A constant to pass for an empty object to json encode.

llprim.tooltip: Utilities for working with prims / objects

ParamSetter.tooltip: Metatable for building lists to pass to ll.SetLinkPrimitiveParamsFast

abs.tooltip: Returns the absolute (positive) value of val.

acos.tooltip: Returns the arccosine of val in radians. Returns NaN if val is not in range [-1.0, 1.0].

asin.tooltip: Returns the arcsine of val in radians. Returns NaN if val is not in range [-1.0, 1.0].

atan.tooltip: Returns the arctangent of val in radians.

atan2.tooltip: Returns the arctangent of y/x in radians, using the signs to determine the quadrant. Note the argument order: Y is the first parameter, X is the second parameter.

ceil.tooltip: Returns val rounded toward positive infinity. In other words, returns the smallest integer greater than or equal to val.

clamp.tooltip: Returns val clamped between min and max. Raises an error if min is greater than max.

cos.tooltip: Returns the cosine of theta. Theta is in radians.

cosh.tooltip: Returns the hyperbolic cosine of n.

deg.tooltip: Returns theta converted from radians to degrees.

exp.tooltip: Returns the e to the power of val.

floor.tooltip: Returns val rounded toward negative infinity. In other words, returns the largest integer less than or equal to val.

fmod.tooltip: Returns the remainder (modulo) of dividend/modulus, (i.e. d mod m), rounded towards zero. Returns NaN if modulus is 0. Identical to d % m if both arguments have the same sign.

frexp.tooltip: Breaks a floating-point number into it's component parts significand and exponent. In other words, Returns significand s and integer exponent e such that val = s * 2^e. Inverse of math.ldexp.

lerp.tooltip: Linearly interpolates between start_val and end_val using factor t.

log.tooltip: Returns the logarithm of val in the given base. The default base is e.

log10.tooltip: Returns the base-10 logarithm of val.

map.tooltip: Maps val from input range to output range.

max.tooltip: Returns the maximum value from the given numbers.

min.tooltip: Returns the minimum value from the given numbers.

modf.tooltip: Returns the integer and fractional parts of val.

noise.tooltip: Returns a Perlin noise value for the point (x, y, z). The return value is in the range [-1.0, 1.0].

pow.tooltip: Returns base to the power of exponent.

rad.tooltip: Returns theta converted from degrees to radians.

random.tooltip: Returns a random number within the given range.

randomseed.tooltip: Sets the seed for the random number generator.

deprecated.reason: Disabled in SLua.

round.tooltip: Returns val rounded to the nearest integer. Halfway values are rounded away from zero.

sign.tooltip: Returns -1 if val is negative, 1 if positive, and 0 if zero.

sin.tooltip: Returns the sine of theta. Theta is in radians.

sinh.tooltip: Returns the hyperbolic sine of val.

sqrt.tooltip: Returns the square root of val. If negative, return Nan.

tan.tooltip: Returns the tangent of theta. Theta is in radians.

tanh.tooltip: Returns the hyperbolic tangent of val.

isnan.tooltip: Returns true if val is NaN.

isinf.tooltip: Returns true if val is infinite.

isfinite.tooltip: Returns true if val is finite.

huge.tooltip: Value larger than any other numeric value (infinity). 1/0.

nan.tooltip: Value representing an error (not a number). 0/0.

pi.tooltip: Ratio of a circle's circumference to its diameter. The number of radians in a half circle (semi-circle). math.tau/2.

tau.tooltip: Ratio of a circle's circumference to its radius. The number of radians in a full circle. math.pi*2.

clock.tooltip: Returns a high-precision timestamp in seconds for measuring durations. Has a resolution of 0.0001s (222 ticks per server frame, 3 ticks per script time slice). 6-11x slower to look up than ll.GetTime.

date.tooltip: Returns a table or string representation of the time based on the provided format.

difftime.tooltip: Returns the difference in seconds between two timestamps. Same as a - b.

deprecated.reason: Same as a - b

time.tooltip: Returns the current Unix timestamp or the timestamp of the given date.

create.tooltip: Creates a new quaternion with the given component values.

normalize.tooltip: Returns the normalized unit quaternion pointing the same direction as q. If <0, 0, 0, 0>, return quaternion.identity = <0, 0, 0, 1>.

magnitude.tooltip: Returns the magnitude (geometric length) of the quaternion.

dot.tooltip: Returns the dot product of two quaternions.

slerp.tooltip: Spherical linear interpolation from start_q to end_q using factor t.

conjugate.tooltip: Returns the conjugate of the quaternion. Equivalent to quaternion(-q.x, -q.y, -q.z, q.s))

tofwd.tooltip: Returns the unit vector pointing toward positive X direction (forward) in the coordinate space of rotation q. Equivalent to vector(1, 0, 0) * q.

toleft.tooltip: Returns the unit vector pointing toward positive Y direction (left) in the coordinate space of rotation q. Equivalent to vector(0, 1, 0) * q.

toup.tooltip: Returns the unit vector pointing toward positive Z direction (up) in the coordinate space of rotation q. Equivalent to vector(0, 0, 1) * q.

identity.tooltip: Identity quaternion constant. Causes no change when rotated.

byte.tooltip: Returns the numeric code of every byte in the range start_index..end_index in the string src. Negative indices count backward from the end of the string.

char.tooltip: Constructs and returns a string from the given byte integers.

find.tooltip: Returns the start and end byte indices of the first occurrence of pattern inside the string src, followed by any regex-captured substrings. Search starts from start_index. Returns nil if not found. Negative indices count backward from the end of the string.

format.tooltip: Formats input values into a string using printf-style format specifiers.

gmatch.tooltip: Returns an iterator function of all occurences of the regex pattern inside the string src.

gsub.tooltip: Returns a copy of src with maxn occurrences of the regex pattern replaced by repl, followed by the total number of substitutions that occurred. repl can be a string, function, or table.

len.tooltip: Returns the number of bytes in the string. Identical to #str.

lower.tooltip: Returns a lowercase copy of the string src. Only converts ASCII characters. Use ll.ToLower for strings that may contain Unicode.

match.tooltip: Returns all occurences of the regex pattern inside the string src, starting from start_index. Returns nil if no match is found. Negative indices count backward from the end of the string.

pack.tooltip: Packs values into a binary string.

packsize.tooltip: Returns the size of a packed string for the given format.

rep.tooltip: Returns the string src repeated n times. Returns an empty string if n is zero or negative.

reverse.tooltip: Returns a copy of the string src with bytes in reverse order.

split.tooltip: Splits a string by separator. Returns a list of substrings. If the separator is nil, splits at commas (","). If the separator is empty, splits into individual one-byte substrings.

sub.tooltip: Returns a copy of the substring from src within the inclusive byte range start_index..end_index. Negative indices count backward from the end of the string.

unpack.tooltip: Decodes a binary string using a pack format, starting from index start and returns a tuple of the decoded values, followed by a number representing the index of the first unread byte. Negative indices count backward from the end of the string.

upper.tooltip: Returns an uppercase copy of the string src. Only converts ASCII characters. Use ll.ToUpper for strings that may contain Unicode.

table.tooltip: Table manipulation library. Tables are collections of key-value pairs.

concat.tooltip: Joins an array of strings into one string, with an optional separator.

foreach.tooltip: Iterates over all key-value pairs in the table (deprecated).

deprecated.reason: Use a for loop instead

foreachi.tooltip: Iterates over all index-value pairs in the array (deprecated).

deprecated.reason: Use a for loop instead

getn.tooltip: Returns the length of an array (deprecated; use # instead).

maxn.tooltip: Returns the highest numeric key in the table.

insert.tooltip: Inserts an element at index i, shifting subsequent elements up by 1. The index must be within the range [1, #a].

append.tooltip: Appends one or more elements to the end of the array.

extend.tooltip: Appends all elements from one array to the end of another. Shorthand for table.move(b, 1, #b, #a+1, a).

remove.tooltip: Removes and returns the element at index i, shifting subsequent elements down by 1. Defaults to the end of the array. Returns nil if no element was removed.

pack.tooltip: Packs arguments into a table and sets an 'n' field with the total count. This is the safest way to pack varargs (...) that might contain nil values.

unpack.tooltip: Unpacks array elements into multiple return values.

move.tooltip: Copies elements [i..j] from src array into dest array starting at [d], overwriting existing elements.

create.tooltip: Creates a new table with pre-allocated array capacity, optionally filled. Preallocation only benefits array portions and is counter-productive for dictionaries.

find.tooltip: Finds the first occurrence of a value in the array and returns its index. Traversal stops at the first nil.

clear.tooltip: Clears all elements from a table while keeping its capacity to avoid memory reallocations during future assignments.

shrink.tooltip: Reduces the memory usage of the table to the minimum necessary.

freeze.tooltip: Freezes a table, making it read-only. The freeze is shallow and does not affect nested tables. Raises an error if the table is already frozen or has a protected metatable.

isfrozen.tooltip: Returns true if a table is frozen.

clone.tooltip: Creates a shallow copy of the table, copying its keys, values, and metatable. The clone is always unfrozen even if the source was frozen.

char.tooltip: Constructs and returns a string from the given Unicode codepoint ordinals.

codes.tooltip: Returns an iterator that produces the byte offset and Unicode codepoint for each character in the string src.

codepoint.tooltip: Returns the ordinals (Unicode copepoint integers) of the characters in the inclusive byte range start_index..end_index in the string src. Negative indices count backward from the end of the string.

len.tooltip: Returns the number of Unicode codepoints in the inclusive byte range start_index..end_index of the string src. If the string is not utf8, returns (nil, error index) instead. Negative indices count backward from the end of the string.

offset.tooltip: Returns the byte offset of the nth Unicode codepoint in the string. Negative indices count backward from the end of the string.

charpattern.tooltip: Pattern that matches exactly one UTF-8 byte sequence.

create.tooltip: Creates a new uuid from a string, buffer, or existing uuid. Throws an error if the string is not a valid UUID, or the buffer is shorter than 16 bytes.

magnitude.tooltip: Returns the magnitude (geometric length) of the vector.

normalize.tooltip: Returns the normalized unit vector pointing the same direction as vec. If <0, 0, 0>, return <NaN, NaN, NaN>.

cross.tooltip: Returns the cross product of two vectors.

dot.tooltip: Returns the dot product of two vectors.

angle.tooltip: Returns the angle from start_vec to end_vec in radians. The axis, if specified, is used to determine the sign of the angle. If no axis is specified, the angle is positive, as if axis was vector.cross(start_vec, end_vec).

floor.tooltip: Applies math.floor to each component of the vector.

ceil.tooltip: Applies math.ceil to each component of the vector.

abs.tooltip: Applies math.abs to each component of the vector.

sign.tooltip: Applies math.sign to each component of the vector.

clamp.tooltip: Clamps each component of the vector between min and max values.

max.tooltip: Applies math.max to each component of the vectors.

min.tooltip: Applies math.min to each component of the vectors.

lerp.tooltip: Linearly interpolates between start_vec and end_vec using factor t.

zero.tooltip: Vector constant with all components set to 0.

one.tooltip: Vector constant with all components set to 1.
