globals.name: rotation
globals.tooltip: rotation is an alias for quaternion.

globals.name: LLEvents
globals.tooltip: Event registration and management singleton for Second Life events.

globals.name: LLTimers
globals.tooltip: Timer management singleton for scheduling periodic and one-time callbacks.

builtins.name: assert
builtins.tooltip: Checks if the value is truthy; if not, raises an error with the optional message. Returns the value upon success.

builtins.name: collectgarbage
builtins.tooltip: Run the garbage collector

builtins.name: dangerouslyexecuterequiredmodule
builtins.tooltip: Dangerously executes a required module function

builtins.name: error
builtins.tooltip: Raises an error with the specified object. The optional level determines which call stack level is blamed for the error.

builtins.name: gcinfo
builtins.tooltip: Returns the total heap size in kilobytes.

builtins.name: getfenv
builtins.tooltip: Get the scoped environment for the given function.

builtins.name: getmetatable
builtins.tooltip: Returns the metatable for the specified object. If the metatable has a '__metatable' field, returns its value instead.

builtins.name: graphheap
builtins.tooltip: Writes the contents of heap to the given file in JSON format. Intended to be used with tools/graphanalyze.py

builtins.name: graphuserheap
builtins.tooltip: Writes the contents of user heap to the given file in JSON format. Intended to be used with tools/graphanalyze.py

builtins.name: ipairs
builtins.tooltip: Returns an iterator for sequential integer key-value pairs in the table. Iteration starts at 1 and halts at the first nil value.

builtins.name: loadstring
builtins.tooltip: Compile Luau code into a function.

builtins.name: newproxy
builtins.tooltip: Creates a new untyped userdata object with an optional metatable.

builtins.name: next
builtins.tooltip: Returns the next key-value pair in the table traversal order. If the index is nil or omitted, returns the first pair.

builtins.name: pairs
builtins.tooltip: Returns an iterator for all key-value pairs in the table.

builtins.name: pcall
builtins.tooltip: Executes function f in protected mode, calling it with the provided arguments. Returns a boolean indicating success. If true, it also returns the function's results. If false, it returns the error message.

builtins.name: print
builtins.tooltip: Sends all arguments as text privately to the object owner, separated by 4 spaces. The owner must be currently in the same region for the message to be received.

builtins.name: rawequal
builtins.tooltip: Returns true if a and b have the same type and value or reference, bypassing the __eq metamethod..

builtins.name: rawget
builtins.tooltip: Performs a table lookup, bypassing the __index metamethod..

builtins.name: rawlen
builtins.tooltip: Returns the length of a table or string, bypassing the __len metamethod..

builtins.name: rawset
builtins.tooltip: Assigns a value to a table field, bypassing the __newindex metamethod..

builtins.name: require
builtins.tooltip: Execute the named external module.

builtins.name: select
builtins.tooltip: Returns a subset of arguments starting from the specified index. Supports negative indexing. If index is '#', returns the number of arguments.

builtins.name: setfenv
builtins.tooltip: Set the scoped environment for the given function.

builtins.name: setmetatable
builtins.tooltip: Changes the metatable for the given table. Raises an error if the table already has a protected metatable (it has a '__metatable' field).

builtins.name: tonumber
builtins.tooltip: Converts the input string to a number in the specified base. Returns nil if invalid.

builtins.name: toquaternion
builtins.tooltip: Converts a string to a quaternion. Returns nil if invalid.

builtins.name: torotation
builtins.tooltip: Converts a string to a rotation (quaternion). Returns nil if invalid.

builtins.name: tostring
builtins.tooltip: Converts the input object to a string. Calls the metatable's '__tostring' metamethod if present.

builtins.name: touuid
builtins.tooltip: Creates a new uuid from a string, buffer, or existing uuid. Returns nil if the string is not a valid UUID, or the buffer is shorter than 16 bytes.

builtins.name: tovector
builtins.tooltip: Converts a string to a vector. Returns nil if invalid.

builtins.name: type
builtins.tooltip: Returns the type of the object as a string.

builtins.name: typeof
builtins.tooltip: Returns the type of the object, including custom userdata types.

builtins.name: unpack
builtins.tooltip: Returns values from an array in the specified index range.

builtins.name: xpcall
builtins.tooltip: Calls function f with the provided arguments, handling errors with err if they occur.

state_entry.tooltip: Triggered immediately whenever a new state is entered (including at script start). It is always the first event handled.

state_exit.tooltip: Triggered when the state command is used to transition out of the current state. Handled before entering the new state's state_entry.

arguments.name: num_detected
arguments.tooltip: Total number of touching agents detected (usable with llDetected* functions).

touch_start.tooltip: Triggered when an avatar first touches the object. Passes num_detected, representing the number of touching agents.

arguments.name: num_detected
arguments.tooltip: Total number of touching agents detected (usable with llDetected* functions).

touch.tooltip: Triggered continuously while an avatar touches the object. Passes num_detected, representing the number of touching agents.

arguments.name: num_detected
arguments.tooltip: Total number of touching agents detected (usable with llDetected* functions).

touch_end.tooltip: Triggered when an avatar stops touching the object. Passes num_detected, representing the number of touching agents.

arguments.name: num_detected
arguments.tooltip: Total number of detected colliders (usable with llDetected* functions).

collision_start.tooltip: Triggered when an avatar or another object first begins colliding with the object containing the script. Passes num_detected, representing the number of detected collisions.

arguments.name: num_detected
arguments.tooltip: Total number of detected colliders (usable with llDetected* functions).

collision.tooltip: Triggered continuously while an avatar or another object is colliding with the object containing the script. Passes num_detected, representing the number of detected collisions.

arguments.name: num_detected
arguments.tooltip: Total number of detected colliders (usable with llDetected* functions).

collision_end.tooltip: Triggered when an avatar or another object stops colliding with the object containing the script. Passes num_detected, representing the number of detected collisions.

arguments.name: pos
arguments.tooltip: Vector position of collision with the ground.

land_collision_start.tooltip: Triggered in the root prim when a physical object or attached avatar first begins colliding with the ground at position pos.

arguments.name: pos
arguments.tooltip: Vector position of collision with the ground.

land_collision.tooltip: Triggered in the root prim when a physical object or attached avatar is colliding with the ground at position pos.

arguments.name: pos
arguments.tooltip: Vector position of the last ground collision.

land_collision_end.tooltip: Triggered in the root prim when a physical object or attached avatar stops colliding with the ground at position pos.

timer.tooltip: Triggered at regular periodic intervals configured by llSetTimerEvent.

arguments.name: channel
arguments.tooltip: Chat channel where the message appeared.

arguments.name: name
arguments.tooltip: Name of the sending prim or the legacy name of the sending agent.

arguments.name: id
arguments.tooltip: UUID of the sending agent or prim.

arguments.name: msg
arguments.tooltip: Spoken text string.

listen.tooltip: Triggered when a chat message matching active llListen filters is received on channel. Passes the sender's name and UUID key id, along with the spoken string msg.

arguments.name: start_param
arguments.tooltip: Integer start parameter passed from the rezzing call.

on_rez.tooltip: Triggered when the object is rezzed into the world (by a script or user). Passes start_param from the rezzing call (or 0 if rezzed from inventory). Also triggers on attachments during login or when attached from inventory.

arguments.name: num_detected
arguments.tooltip: Total number of detected targets found (usable with llDetected* functions).

sensor.tooltip: Triggered when objects matching constraints of llSensor or llSensorRepeat are successfully detected. Passes num_detected, representing the number of detected targets.

no_sensor.tooltip: Triggered when active sensors (from llSensor or llSensorRepeat) complete a scan without finding any matching targets.

arguments.name: id
arguments.tooltip: UUID of the avatar whose inputs are captured.

arguments.name: level
arguments.tooltip: A bitfield of CONTROL_* constants representing currently held controls.

arguments.name: edge
arguments.tooltip: A bitfield of CONTROL_* constants representing controls that just changed state.

control.tooltip: Triggered to pass captured avatar control inputs into the script. The parameter level indicates held controls, and edge indicates change in controls (both are bitfields of CONTROL_* constants).

arguments.name: id
arguments.tooltip: UUID of the paying resident.

arguments.name: amount
arguments.tooltip: Quantity of L$ paid to the prim.

money.tooltip: Triggered when a resident specified by id pays an amount of Linden dollars (L$) to the prim.

arguments.name: time
arguments.tooltip: Timestamp of when the email was received, in (string)llGetUnixTime() format.

arguments.name: address
arguments.tooltip: Email address of the sender.

arguments.name: subject
arguments.tooltip: Subject of the email.

arguments.name: msg
arguments.tooltip: Body text of the email.

arguments.name: num_left
arguments.tooltip: Number of emails still waiting in the queue.

email.tooltip: Receive an email requested by llGetNextEmail(). NumberRemaining indicates the number of emails remaining in the queue for llGetNextEmail() to retrieve.

arguments.name: tnum
arguments.tooltip: Integer target handle returned by the llTarget call.

arguments.name: targetpos
arguments.tooltip: Target position vector specified in the llTarget call.

arguments.name: ourpos
arguments.tooltip: Current position vector of the object (similar to llGetPos).

at_target.tooltip: Triggered when the scripted object's position (ourpos) comes within the defined range of the target position (targetpos) set by llTarget (which returns the associated handle tnum).

not_at_target.tooltip: Triggered continuously while the object's position has not yet reached the range of targets set via llTarget.

arguments.name: handle
arguments.tooltip: Integer handle returned by the llRotTarget call.

arguments.name: targetrot
arguments.tooltip: Target rotation specified in the llRotTarget call.

arguments.name: ourrot
arguments.tooltip: Current rotation of the object (similar to llGetRot).

at_rot_target.tooltip: Triggered when the script's rotation (ourrot) comes within a defined angle (error) of the target rotation (targetrot) set by a call to llRotTarget (which returns the associated handle).

not_at_rot_target.tooltip: Triggered continuously while the object's rotation is outside the leeway angle of targets set via llRotTarget.

arguments.name: perm
arguments.tooltip: Bitfield of currently granted permissions (PERMISSION_* flags).

run_time_permissions.tooltip: Triggered when an agent grants or denies runtime permissions requested by llRequestPermissions. Passes the active integer permissions bitfield perm (returns 0 if no permissions are currently granted).

arguments.name: changes
arguments.tooltip: A bitfield of CHANGED_* flags representing what changed.

changed.tooltip: Triggered when various properties of the object change. The parameter changes is a bitfield of CHANGED_* flags.

arguments.name: avatar
arguments.tooltip: UUID of the avatar the object is attached to, or NULL_KEY if detached.

attach.tooltip: Triggered whenever the object is attached to or detached from an avatar. Passes the UUID key of the avatar if attached, or NULL_KEY if detached.

arguments.name: queryid
arguments.tooltip: Key identifying the asynchronous request (matches the handle returned by the requesting function).

arguments.name: data
arguments.tooltip: String containing the requested data.

dataserver.tooltip: Triggered when requested data is returned to the script (e.g., from llRequestAgentData, llRequestInventoryData, or llGetNotecardLine).

arguments.name: sender_num
arguments.tooltip: Link index of the prim containing the script that sent the message.

arguments.name: num
arguments.tooltip: An integer value passed from the sending script.

arguments.name: str
arguments.tooltip: A text string value passed from the sending script.

arguments.name: id
arguments.tooltip: A key value passed from the sending script.

link_message.tooltip: Triggered when the script receives a link message from sender_num, containing the parameters num, str, and id sent via llMessageLinked.

moving_start.tooltip: Triggered whenever the physical or moving object containing the script starts moving.

moving_end.tooltip: Triggered whenever the physical or moving object containing the script stops moving.

arguments.name: id
arguments.tooltip: UUID of the newly rezzed object.

object_rez.tooltip: Triggered when this object successfully rezzes another object from its inventory. Passes the key (UUID) id of the newly rezzed object.

arguments.name: event_type
arguments.tooltip: Integer constant representing the type of XML-RPC event.

arguments.name: channel
arguments.tooltip: XML-RPC channel ID key.

arguments.name: message_id
arguments.tooltip: XML-RPC message ID key.

arguments.name: sender
arguments.tooltip: XML-RPC sender string.

arguments.name: idata
arguments.tooltip: Payload integer data.

arguments.name: sdata
arguments.tooltip: Payload string data.

remote_data.tooltip: Deprecated. Triggered by incoming XML-RPC calls, passing event_type, channel, message_id, sender, idata, and sdata.

arguments.name: request_id
arguments.tooltip: Key matching the handle returned by the initiating llHTTPRequest call.

arguments.name: status
arguments.tooltip: Integer HTTP status code returned (such as 200 or 404).

arguments.name: metadata
arguments.tooltip: A list of HTTP_* constants and response headers metadata.

arguments.name: body
arguments.tooltip: String payload of the received response body.

http_response.tooltip: Triggered when an HTTP response body is received for a pending request_id, or if the request fails or times out.

arguments.name: request_id
arguments.tooltip: Unique key identifying the incoming HTTP request (used with llHTTPResponse).

arguments.name: method
arguments.tooltip: HTTP method string ('GET', 'POST', 'PUT', 'DELETE') or URL request status constants.

arguments.name: body
arguments.tooltip: String payload of the incoming request body.

http_request.tooltip: Triggered when the script's registered URL receives an incoming HTTP request identified by request_id.

arguments.name: agent_id
arguments.tooltip: UUID of the avatar approving experience permissions.

experience_permissions.tooltip: Triggered when the agent specified by agent_id approves an experience permissions request (interactively or automatically if previously approved).

arguments.name: id
arguments.tooltip: Key matching the handle returned by the initiating llTransfer* function.

arguments.name: success
arguments.tooltip: Boolean. TRUE if the L$ transfer succeeded, FALSE otherwise.

arguments.name: data
arguments.tooltip: Contains a CSV string of transaction info on success, or an error string on failure.

transaction_result.tooltip: Triggered when an asynchronous L$ transfer (such as llTransferLindenDollars) is completed. Passes transaction info id, success status, and CSV or error data.

arguments.name: type
arguments.tooltip: Path update status or failure code constant (PU_* flag).

arguments.name: reserved
arguments.tooltip: Reserved parameter (currently unused).

path_update.tooltip: Triggered to inform the script of changes or failures in the pathfinding character's status.

arguments.name: agent_id
arguments.tooltip: UUID of the avatar who denied or was blocked from granting permissions.

arguments.name: reason
arguments.tooltip: XP_ERROR_* error constant describing why permissions were denied.

experience_permissions_denied.tooltip: Triggered when the agent specified by agent_id denies experience permissions, or when permission is blocked for other reasons (specified by the error code reason).

arguments.name: action
arguments.tooltip: Action taken (LINKSETDATA_UPDATE, LINKSETDATA_DELETE, LINKSETDATA_MULTIDELETE, or LINKSETDATA_RESET).

arguments.name: name
arguments.tooltip: Name of the modified key (a comma-separated list of keys for LINKSETDATA_MULTIDELETE, or empty for LINKSETDATA_RESET).

arguments.name: value
arguments.tooltip: New value of the key (empty if the key was deleted or is protected).

linkset_data.tooltip: Fires in all scripts in the linkset whenever the linkset datastore is modified via an llLinksetData function. Passes the action taken, the affected key name, and the new value.

arguments.name: id
arguments.tooltip: UUID of the avatar supplying controller input.

arguments.name: button_levels
arguments.tooltip: A 32-bit mask representing the canonical buttons currently held down on the controller.

arguments.name: axes
arguments.tooltip: A list of six float values in the range [-1.0, 1.0] representing canonical controller axes.

game_control.tooltip: Triggered when a compatible viewer sends game controller input changes for the avatar specified by id. Only triggers for scripts in attachments or seats.

on_death.tooltip: Triggered on all worn attachments when the wearing avatar's health reaches 0.

arguments.name: num_detected
arguments.tooltip: Number of pending damage events.

on_damage.tooltip: Triggered when damage has been inflicted on an avatar or task, but before it is applied or distributed. Collision detected functions (llDetected*), llDetectedDamage, and llAdjustDamage are available. Passes num_detected, representing the number of pending damage events.

arguments.name: num_detected
arguments.tooltip: Number of damage events applied to the avatar or task.

final_damage.tooltip: Triggered after all on_damage events across all scripts have completed and damage is actively applied to the avatar or distributed among seated avatars. Collision detected functions (llDetected*) and llDetectedDamage are available.
